# Classifieds
[italic]Notices from readers of Fort McNeil, set as received. The Herald does not vouch for any of it. Drill crews advertise free.[/italic]
## Housing - [bold]BUNK SWAP[/bold], dormitory, top bunk for bottom bunk. Current top bunk has a ceiling vent that whistles. Ask for the night shift driller in the end room. - Official allocations are posted by the colony at [netlink="Seegson housing assignments" link="colony.seegson.net/housing"].
## Work - [bold]DRILL HANDS WANTED[/bold] for the southern site. Must keep a mask on in the dust and a clear head in the heat. - [bold]CAVE GUIDE[/bold], ten years under the colony, will walk survey crews in and back out again. Out again is the expensive part. - [bold]HYDROPONICS[/bold] needs a spare pair of hands for the harvest. Paid in wages and in tomatoes.
## For Sale and Trade - [bold]CARGO TRUCK[/bold], small, old, leaks oil, smells of juice. Runs. Mostly. Best offer. - [bold]WALL TELEPHONE[/bold], keycard slot jammed, receive button works. Free to anyone who can make it call out. - [bold]DUST FILTERS[/bold], new in the packet. Trade for real coffee or a working shortwave.
## Lost and Found - [bold]LOST[/bold]: pet rat, brown, answers to Shift Boss. Last seen leaving the outhouse module at speed.
## Notices - The R&R: happy hour after every quota shift. Security drinks at full price. - To the miner asking who the union reps are: they know where you sleep, in the friendly way.
To place a notice, find the Herald's correspondent or leave a comment under any story on the front page.
